skills.name: audit-skill
skills.description: Audit an agent skill's contract, grants, and cost: whether its Markdown names the lines and exit codes its scripts print, its allowed-tools grants and listing, deterministic work left to prose, token footprint, tool calls, subagents, and model. Read-only findings report. Use it when asked to audit or check a skill: whether its allowed-tools grants are too broad, whether its SKILL.md names the lines its scripts print, what it costs to run or why it is slow, or before shipping it.
